mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that may alter methadone metabolism and increase CNS depression risk; both drugs have cardiac arrhythmia potential.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and methadone levels closely; maintain adequate hydration and consider liposomal formulation of amphotericin B; adjust methadone dosing based on clinical response and levels if renal impairment develops.
